The metadata command family derives the recovery target's validator
metadata from a STOPPED node's shard-0 LevelDB: scan (diagnosis/dry-run),
export-reference (the run-once canonical .hmr + reference JSON producer)
and audit-branch (masked re-execution of the abandoned branch).

Exit codes: 0 OK; 13 unsafe open/concurrent writer; 14 I/O or corruption;
15 invalid config/paths; 16 interrupted; 20 MISSING_REQUIRED_METADATA;
21 INVALID_RETAINED_METADATA; 22 TARGET_STATE_UNAVAILABLE;
23 DETERMINISM_MISMATCH; 24 AUDIT_ANOMALY; 130 SIGINT.

Usage:
  harmony-recovery metadata [flags]
  harmony-recovery metadata [command]

Available Commands:
  audit-branch     Re-execute the abandoned branch over a masked overlay and reconcile every planned deletion
  export-reference Produce the canonical .hmr reference package and reference manifest (run-once producer)
  scan             Diagnose and dry-run the metadata normalization (read-only; run before export and audit)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for metadata

Use "harmony-recovery metadata [command] --help" for more information about a command.
